text:
Sara (Support): Escalating urgent handback for BlueHarbor (large ARR, pilot). Ingest pipeline has been failing intermittently for 72h. Renewal decision window 2024-04-15 — high risk. Need CS to own comms + enablement immediately.

Omar (SE): Seen 429 spikes from our embed endpoint and a couple of KV cache misses. Logs show prefix growth > expected. I tried a quick throttling rule but it's a bandaid.

Sara (Support): attaching last error snippet — getting repeated 429s and some 502s from upstream: 
```
POST /v1/embeddings 429
{"error":"rate limit exceeded"}
```

Priya (CS): Thanks Sara — flagging as priority. Who is the AE contact? Need to loop Exec Sponsor and propose a comms plan.

Evan (AE): Evan here — Exec sponsor is Claire (CTO). Pilot end date is 2024-04-10, they're evaluating latency and reliability for a larger contract. Claire is watching.

Lina (Onboard): Quick ask: do we know which tenant config they're using? multi-embed batching or single per doc? Could impact batching behavior.

Omar (SE): They're on our multi-embed pipeline with batch_size=64 and dynamic batching enabled. Sequence distribution spiked because of a few very long docs. That made the runtime pick different kernel and overflow KV.

Priya (CS): Proposed comms plan: 1) immediate transparency email to Claire + product owner explaining root cause & mitigation steps; 2) schedule focused enablement workshop to walk their infra and recommend config changes; 3) offer a 2-week dedicated capacity window if needed. Agree? I'll draft email. :email:

Evan (AE): Agree. Please cc me and Omar. Highlight the SLA mitigation and a clear timeline. Claire needs concrete next steps.

Sara (Support): Support can collect additional logs and a sample problematic document set for the SEs. Will DM the S3 path to Omar.

Omar (SE): I'll prepare a short runbook and a safe fallback config: set batch_size=16, enable prefix caching TTL=600s, and temp cap model to a smaller variant for the pilot. Patch can be applied by ops.

DeployBot: scheduled rollback job queued for 2024-04-02T03:00:00Z if no patch applied.

Priya (CS): Timeline: today = transparency note to Claire; tomorrow = enablement workshop (30m) with Lina/Omar; within 48h = implement fallback config + monitor; by 2024-04-05 we meet again to decide renew ask.

Lina (Onboard): I can run the workshop tomorrow 10am PT. I'll create the invite and a short checklist for Claire's engineers (API keys, request sampling, doc size).

Evan (AE): 10am PT works for Claire. Please include a slide with expected impact on latency & cost.

Priya (CS): I'll draft the transparency email now and post a thread update. Who owns the follow-up before the workshop?

Sara (Support): I'll own pre-workshop log collection + send sample doc set to Omar.

Omar (SE): I'll own the runbook and the fallback PR. Targeting a canary rollout to one of their namespaces first.

Priya (CS): Great. Action items: 
- Priya: draft email & exec comms (today)
- Sara: collect logs & sample docs (today)
- Omar: runbook + fallback PR (24–48h)
- Lina: enablement workshop invite + checklist (tomorrow 10am PT)
- Evan: prep exec-facing slide on impact & mitigation (tomorrow)

Priya (CS): I'll post the drafted email to this thread for quick review in ~30m. :thumbsup:

Sara (Support): Thanks — marking as P0 handback.

Evan (AE): Thanks team — Claire wants calm, clear steps not engineering jargon. Keep it high level.

Priya (CS): Understood. Will keep it executive-friendly.

Omar (SE): One more note: if we need to offer dedicated capacity, we should include estimated cost delta. I'll ping FinOps for a quick estimate.

Priya (CS): Noted. Will include a placeholder in the email: "estimated cost impact to be provided by our team within 24h."

Sara (Support): Will update thread when logs uploaded to the shared S3 path.

Priya (CS): Thanks everyone — leaning into this now.
